messages:
alex: Heads-up — landing 6:10am after a red-eye. Quick Q: what are your go-to tricks for washing up / looking human before a morning meeting? Need to be in Downtown by 8:30.

maria: airport lounges — day pass or guest invite. showers + towels. sometimes cheaper than a taxi to a hotel :raised_hands:

josh: if lounge not an option, try Dayuse (https://www.dayuse.com) for 4–6h hotel rooms. book near airport.

lina: packing tip: thin microfiber towel, dry shampoo, waterless body wash wipes, travel toothbrush + toothpaste tablets, deodorant stick, change of underwear in carry-on.

peggy: Pro tip — ask hotel for early check-in or for late checkout from previous guest; front desk often has a room to clean faster if you tip the housekeeper :money_with_wings:

ryan: hotel pool works — buy a day pass at the gym/pool area, locker + shower. cheaper at some airport-adjacent hotels.

alex: anyone have a compact checklist i can screenshot? meeting is at 9am and i'd like a 10-min routine.

lina: paste: 
```
- face wipes
- deodorant
- toothbrush paste
- dry shampoo
- quick outfit change (clean unders + shirt)
- small comb
```

maria: + wet wipe for underarms and neck. perfume/cologne lightly. pack tiny zip bag so you can toss trash quickly.

josh: also: wear layers on flight so you can change top quickly without popping out full bag. easy swap in lavs.

trip-bot: Reminder: flight UA102 lands 06:10 local. Estimated deplane time 06:25. ETA to Downtown w/ taxi: 45m normal traffic.

alex: awesome — thanks all. will try lounge day pass first, fallback to dayuse. saving the checklist screenshot. :thumbsup:
